fields.description: The BoQ these summary inputs belong to. ONE current record per BoQ (freeze-and-supersede). Keyed by the BoQ alone, so a sheet re-commit keeps it and Merge BoQs keeps it; a revision gets a copy at its sheet-mapping confirmation (revision.confirm_revision_mapping). No search index of its own: the explicit (boq, is_current) index covers every read.
fields.label: BoQ

fields.description: The area the Electrical installation cost is worked on (area x the Pricing Input elec_bcs_install_per_sqft). Blank or 0 = not entered (an area of 0 sq ft is no area).
fields.label: Area (sq ft)

fields.description: {"sheets": [sheet names, VERBATIM]} - the sheets this installation cost covers (the ticked, clubbed block). Blank = the default ticks (sheets whose Suggest population is majority Electrical).
fields.label: Covered Sheets

fields.description: The user's figure for the area part of the installation cost; read only when Area Part Overridden is ticked (0 = the part removed). Frappe writes a blank Currency as 0, hence the Check.
fields.label: Area Part Figure

fields.description: 0 = the system's figure (area x Rs per sq ft); 1 = the user edited or removed it (shows 'changed by user').
fields.label: Area Part Overridden

fields.description: The user's figure for the floor-cutting part; read only when Floor Cutting Overridden is ticked (0 = removed).
fields.label: Floor Cutting Figure

fields.description: 0 = the system's figure (metres x tray_cutting_amount over the caught rows); 1 = the user edited or removed it.
fields.label: Floor Cutting Overridden

fields.description: Per-BoQ version, max prior + 1 on every save (freeze-and-supersede). A record is never overwritten in place.
fields.label: Input Version

fields.description: Exactly one current record per BoQ, enforced by the write path (api/boq/wizard/boq_summary.py), not this controller. The prior current is frozen with frappe.db.set_value(is_current=0).
fields.label: Is Current

fields.description: When the latest save was written.
fields.label: Edited At
